title_original: IfcExportAs Parameter doesn't work
question_paraphrase: Slab edges still export as IfcBuildingElementProxy even though an IfcExportAs parameter set to IfcSlab was added.
phrasing_notes: short title, parameter name quoted verbatim, no version in title
answer_summary: Mentor suggested a shared parameter on the family; poster replied it cannot be done for system families like slab edges. No solution in thread.

title_original: The IFC class is not exported correctly to the IFC model
question_paraphrase: Wall sweeps should come out as IfcCovering but arrive as IfcBuildingElementProxy; changing IFC Export Class and a global IfcExportAs parameter did not help.
phrasing_notes: states desired class, lists what was tried
answer_summary: No reply with a fix in the retrieved snippet.

title_original: IFC export issue (security devices)
question_paraphrase: Security devices export as proxies while electrical equipment exports correctly.
answer_summary: Replies: check per-category IFC class in export options, and use the interoperability tools to set IFC class.

title_original: Revit IFC Export user defined properties won't export
question_paraphrase: Custom properties defined in the user-defined property set file do not appear in the exported IFC.
phrasing_notes: solved-tag thread; names the feature as in UI
answer_summary: Accepted solution thread; typical causes: txt file format, element scope (IfcElement vs IfcWall), type-vs-instance, duplicate parameter names.

title_original: Problem with IFC Export - User defined property sets
question_paraphrase: User-defined property sets do not behave as expected on export.
answer_summary: Check pset txt syntax, parameter names and that the file is loaded in the setup.

title_original: IFC export: User Defined Property Sets
question_paraphrase: Asks how to correctly set up user-defined property sets for IFC export.
answer_summary: Use DefaultUserDefinedParameterSets as template, load in export setup.

title_original: IFC Export- Only part of user defined property set are exported
question_paraphrase: Only some parameters from a user-defined property set make it into the IFC.
answer_summary: Check for duplicate parameter names and type-vs-instance setting.

title_original: Ifc export in 2027 - mapping parameters severely lacking
question_paraphrase: The new Revit 2027 parameter mapping GUI replacing the pset.txt workflow lists only some parameters; project parameters are missing from the selection list, some classes show empty lists.
answer_summary: Other users report same; Autodesk acknowledged empty-list problem as known issue with no ETA.

title_original: GUI for Project Parameter Mapping in IFC Export Missing in Revit 2027
question_paraphrase: Asks to restore a GUI for mapping project parameters to IFC property sets in 2027.
answer_summary: Idea board entry, gathering support.

title_original: Certain shared parameters not exported to IFC from Revit (Autodesk KB)
question_paraphrase: Some shared parameters are exported by one team member and missing for another; how to create a property set so parameters are included.
answer_summary: Build property set txt from DefaultUserDefinedParameterSets, same shared parameter file and exporter version for all, check duplicate names, enable type properties in instance psets.

title_original: Solved: IFC Shared Coordinates Export issue.
question_paraphrase: Exported IFC with shared coordinates lands in a different place from the Revit model.
answer_summary: Accepted fix: tick the option putting IfcSite elevation in site local placement and check project base point angle and elevation.

title_original: Why does Revit not give an option for Positioning when linking IFC files
question_paraphrase: Link IFC offers no positioning option; why.
answer_summary: Moderator: IFC link is always internal origin to internal origin.

title_original: IFC exports at wrong elevation even when ifcSite is ticked
question_paraphrase: Elevation is off in IFC even though the IfcSite elevation option is checked.
answer_summary: Some users still saw ~20 cm offsets; check base point settings.

title_original: PR: Rooms exported with wrong elevation with shared coordinates
question_paraphrase: With shared coordinates rooms are exported high above the rest by the project elevation; fine when shared coordinates are zeroed.
phrasing_notes: GitHub bug template, diagnosed by poster
answer_summary: Cause: levels using Survey Point as elevation base; Autodesk acknowledged (internal ticket) and working on fix.

title_original: REVIT 2019 LT: IFC Export - IFCSpaces are missing
question_paraphrase: IfcSpace entities do not appear in IFC exported from Revit LT.
answer_summary: Related threads: choose phase of rooms in export options, try IFC4 with space boundaries.

title_original: Is it possible to exclude areas from IFC export?
question_paraphrase: How to keep Areas out of the IFC.
answer_summary: Project parameter IfcExportAs=DONTEXPORT on the Area or Room category.

title_original: How do I exclude specific spaces from being exported?
question_paraphrase: Previously set DontExport in IfcExportAs; after 2023 that no longer seems to work.
answer_summary: Set built-in Export to IFC = No; DontExport string no longer in source.

title_original: Revit 2023 IfcExportAs and Type parameter ignored
question_paraphrase: Since 2023 the old IfcExportAs parameter is ignored; keyschedules and global parameters no longer useful; asks for fallback when built-in parameters are empty.
answer_summary: Autodesk logged as open internal issue.

title_original: PR: auto-generated building element proxy type
question_paraphrase: Hundreds of IfcBuildingElementProxyType objects are auto-generated, probably from curtain wall reveals; cannot set IfcExportAs on them and clients see proxies without data.
answer_summary: Autodesk could not reproduce without a sample file.

title_original: Decomposition relationship between nested shared family and its parent
question_paraphrase: Nested shared families export as separate objects with no relation to parent (e.g. door leaf, frame, closer).
context_given: door family with nested shared families
answer_summary: Open issue; maintainers asked for examples.

title_original: Advanced IFC Export of Curtain Wall / Revit 2018
question_paraphrase: Curtain wall panels are hidden deep in IFC hierarchy.
answer_summary: Replies: check 2x3 vs IFC4 and settings at global/type/instance level.

title_original: Export curtain wall to IFC as a single object
question_paraphrase: How to get the whole curtain wall as one IFC object.
answer_summary: Revit exports one IfcCurtainWall as aggregate retaining parts.

title_original: Solved: "Ghost" Mullions in IFC Export
question_paraphrase: Mullions show up in the IFC that are not in the Revit model.
answer_summary: Duplicate/overlapping curtain walls; rebuilding the wall fixed it.

title_original: Ifc export ducts and pipes
question_paraphrase: Ducts and pipes show as generic types after export.
answer_summary: In 2x3 only IfcFlowSegment; IfcDuctSegment/IfcPipeSegment exist from IFC4; use IfcExportAs to force class.

title_original: Losing duct fitting material when exported to IFC files.
question_paraphrase: Duct fitting material disappears in IFC.
answer_summary: Workaround: IfcSingleMaterialOverride parameter in IFC group naming a material.

title_original: Solved: Elements are being exported to the wrong IFC level
question_paraphrase: Elements land in the wrong IfcBuildingStorey.
answer_summary: Levels split between Project Base Point and Survey Point as base; set all to same base point; check Building Story flag.

title_original: How to control the IFC building storey a Revit element is mapped and exported to?
question_paraphrase: Wants control over which storey an element is assigned.
answer_summary: No parameter controls it; derived from host level and settings.

title_original: IFC Basequantities missing on some elements
question_paraphrase: BaseQuantities property set missing on some walls and roofs, mostly with voids.
answer_summary: Version-dependent bug; labels NetSideArea vs gross mismatch in 2020 (GitHub #198).

title_original: Revit - Schedule as property sets missing area and perimeter in IFC
question_paraphrase: Exported schedule property sets lack area and perimeter.
answer_summary: Check schedule export settings.

title_original: Revit 2024.3 Update - Revit crashes every time I export IFC!!!
question_paraphrase: After the 2024.3 update Revit crashes at every IFC export.
answer_summary: Conflicting add-in (e.g. Graphisoft ArchiCAD IFC add-in) removal; solved tag.

title_original: Export to IFC is not working (the Revit file stays not responding for more than 12 hours)
question_paraphrase: IFC export hangs for 12+ hours.
answer_summary: Trusses/dense families cause it; lower LOD, split model, find stalling element id in journal.

title_original: Faster IFC Export
question_paraphrase: Asks for multi-threaded/faster IFC export.
answer_summary: Still request only.

title_original: Revit IFC4x3 export incorrect space boundaries
question_paraphrase: Space boundaries lose links to envelope elements under IFC4x3 but IFC4 Reference View works.
answer_summary: Use IFC4 Reference View or newer exporter from GitHub.

title_original: Issues exporting IFC4x3 / Unexpected errors occurred while exporting these elements
question_paraphrase: Certain door families give 'unexpected errors' on IFC4x3 export.
answer_summary: Autodesk support: fixed in Revit 2026.

title_original: The IFC export process encountered an error
question_paraphrase: Export fails with a generic error; even a new Revit file fails.
answer_summary: Downgrading to exporter 2022.5.1.0 worked.

title_original: Export Revit link as separate IFC with Coarse detail
question_paraphrase: Export linked Revit models as separate IFC at coarse detail.
answer_summary: 'Export links as separate IFC' option; use DONTEXPORT.

title_original: IFC Export result- empty files
question_paraphrase: Document.Export produces empty IFC.
answer_summary: Set ActiveViewId/FilterViewId; transaction required.

title_original: IFC Guid is different in the IFCGuid parameter (written by revit) and the exported IFC
question_paraphrase: IFCGuid parameter differs from the GUID in exported file.
answer_summary: Exporter regenerates GUIDs depending on settings.

title_original: Change classification type in IFC.
question_paraphrase: Export labels BB/SfB codes as Uniformat.
answer_summary: Override in export settings (Assembly Code, custom label).

title_original: Revit 2023 IFC export issue- Floors, Stair was not exported, Export to IFC parameter with By Type
question_paraphrase: Floors and stairs vanish when Export to IFC is 'By Type'.
answer_summary: Set Export to IFC = Yes.

title_original: IFC Export - Element Color Export as per Visibility Graphics (Filters)
question_paraphrase: Colors from view filters are not exported.
answer_summary: Idea open.

title_original: Support Revit Extended Properties in IFC Export
question_paraphrase: Requests export of 2027 Extended Properties.
answer_summary: Gathering support.

title_original: Revit IFC-Export results in wrong position of Rooms
question_paraphrase: Rooms placed in wrong storey in IFC.
answer_summary: Uncheck 'Use 2D room boundaries for room volume'.

title_original: Structural connections IFC parameters
question_paraphrase: Structural connections lack shared parameters in IFC.
answer_summary: Autodesk support said not possible; check Include Steel Elements.

prompt: how many things came out as proxies? list by revit category
expected_behavior: Count IfcBuildingElementProxy, group by Revit category/ObjectType, report with suggested mapping fixes.

prompt: half my shared params arent in the ifc. check which elements have Pset_WallCommon and which dont
expected_behavior: Check walls for Pset_WallCommon and list those missing it, plus which expected custom properties are absent.

prompt: do we have IfcSpace for every room? rooms vs spaces count by level
expected_behavior: Count IfcSpace per storey, compare with a given room list, report missing, check Name/LongName.

prompt: exported with shared coords, is the site/map conversion set right?? where is IfcSite and what are the eastings
expected_behavior: Report IfcMapConversion/IfcProjectedCRS, IfcSite placement and elevation, flag mismatch with project base point.

prompt: some walls ended up on the wrong storey, find walls whose z is outside their IfcBuildingStorey
expected_behavior: Compare element placements to storey elevations, list outliers.

prompt: curtain wall - are panels and mullions children of the IfcCurtainWall? show the tree
expected_behavior: Show IfcRelAggregates decomposition of curtain walls with panel/mullion classes.

prompt: BaseQuantities on walls - NetSideArea and GrossSideArea look the same, can you check?
expected_behavior: Read Qto/BaseQuantities on walls, compare Gross vs Net, flag identical values.

prompt: what IFC classes are my ducts and pipes, flowsegment or proxy? also fittings
expected_behavior: Group MEP elements by class and predefined type; flag proxies.

prompt: does every element have a classification ref? we need Uniclass, not uniformat
expected_behavior: List elements lacking IfcClassificationReference and which classification system is used.

prompt: batch export ifc for each 3D view in the revit project, ifc4 reference view, to a folder
expected_behavior: Create IFCExportOptions per view with ActiveViewId set and export in a transaction.

prompt: compare this export with last weeks, which GUIDs changed and which are new
expected_behavior: Compare GlobalIds between two IFC files, report added/removed/changed.

prompt: ifc export of mep model is 600mb because of flex duct, how to reduce
expected_behavior: Suggest LOD, view-based export, exclude flex duct, zip.

prompt: revit 2027 where did the pset txt go? how do I map project parameters now
expected_behavior: Explain new Parameter Mapping GUI and known limitations.

prompt: set IfcExportAs to IfcCovering for all wall sweeps in the revit model
expected_behavior: In Revit, set export class on wall sweep types, verify.

prompt: ifc4 reference view or 2x3 coordination view for solibri?
expected_behavior: Explain tradeoffs and recommend after checking receiver.

prompt: stairs missing in the ifc, check the Export to IFC param on stair types
expected_behavior: Inspect Export to IFC values on stair/floor types; set to Yes.

prompt: list all rooms with area and department from the ifc for FM, spaces only
expected_behavior: Extract IfcSpace Name, area quantity and department property.
